title: GitHub - lark-sh/lark: Real-time database built on Glommio, drop-in compatible with Firebase RTDB client SDKs.
excerpt: Real-time database built on Glommio, drop-in compatible with Firebase RTDB client SDKs. - lark-sh/lark
content_html:
Lark is a real-time database server that syncs a JSON tree between multiple clients with optional data persistence. It's written primarily in Rust on top of Glommio, with an edge component written in Go for terminating WebSocket, WebTransport, and REST HTTP connections.

You can use it alongside @lark-sh/client to easily create web applications which are realtime.

In addition, Lark is designed to be drop-in compatible with Firebase Realtime Database SDKs, including the Firebase JS SDK. You can use Lark as a replacement for the realtime database, while continuing to use other Firebase features (such as Firebase Auth, Hosting, and Storage).

Lark is proudly open-source, and we believe that every developer should have the option to own their data stack without vendor lock-in.

In addition, Lark Cloud is available for those who want us to handle the devops so you can focus on building your application, while knowing that you always have the option to move onto your own stack in the future.

Full documentation for building on Lark (the client SDK, security rules, the REST API, and Firebase SDK compatibility) lives at docs.larksh.com. The docs/ folder in this repo covers running Lark itself: deployment, backups, observability, and internals. For how Lark is tested, including running Firebase's own SDK test suite against it and crash-testing the durability contract, see TESTING.md.

Quick start

If you're exploring Lark for the first time, you probably have two goals: firstly, get Lark running on your local machine so you can explore the platform; and secondly, see something neat running on top of it so you can get a feel for what's possible.

To do so, you'll need make and Docker. Clone the repo and start Lark from the prebuilt images:

git clone https://github.com/lark-sh/lark.git
cd lark
make up-release

The dashboard is at http://localhost:8080/admin/, and the admin email and one-time password are printed in the log on first start. A lark-data folder will be created in the repo directory which contains your data; backup this folder to backup your data, or delete it if you want to start over fresh.

Want it on the public internet instead? deploy/fly/quickstart.sh stands up a real, TLS-terminated Lark deployment on Fly.io in a few minutes (you'll need a domain). See deploy/fly/README.md.

Try an example app

If you'd like to see something running on top of Lark, check out the examples/ folder:

  • Sticky notes is a multiplayer whiteboard built directly on @lark-sh/client. Live cursors, draggable notes, snapshot-interpolated motion, and volatile-path presence in ~300 lines of vanilla TypeScript. Start here if you're building a new app on Lark.
  • Firebase quickstart runs Firebase's own quickstart-js/database social-blogging app against Lark with a handful of lines changed. Start here if you'd like to see how easy it is to migrate an existing Firebase SDK-based app to Lark.

Compile it yourself

If you'd rather compile Lark from source instead of relying on the prebuilt Docker images, run make up instead of make up-release — it's the same stack, built from the code in your checkout.

Project status

Lark is a new open-source project backed by a production service: Lark Cloud runs this same codebase and hosts real customer data on it today. The engine is continuously tested against an explicit durability contract and verified against Firebase's own SDK test suite; TESTING.md describes both and shows how to run everything yourself.

The 0.x version number reflects the project's age, not known instability. The on-disk format is already something we won't break without providing a migration path, and we don't expect churn in the configuration or wire surfaces beyond new features. We'd rather let Lark earn its 1.0 through public production mileage than declare it on our own confidence. Until then, breaking changes in 0.x releases are rare, documented in the CHANGELOG, and accompanied by a migration path whenever stored data is affected.

Development

If you're looking for details on the technical side of how Lark works, or are interested in coding on the actual Lark service itself instead of just running an app on top of it, check out CONTRIBUTING for an overview of the codebase as well as how to setup a full dev environment.

Lark 是一个实时数据库服务器，可以在多个客户端之间同步 JSON 树，并具有可选的数据持久性。 它主要是在 Glommio 之上用 Rust 编写的，并有一个用 Go 编写的边缘组件，用于终止 WebSocket、WebTransport 和 REST HTTP 连接。

您可以将它与 @lark-sh/client 一起使用来轻松创建实时 Web 应用程序。

此外，Lark 还设计为与 Firebase 实时数据库 SDK（包括 Firebase JS SDK）直接兼容。 您可以使用 Lark 来替代实时数据库，同时继续使用 Firebase 的其他功能（例如 Firebase Auth、Hosting 和 Storage）。

Lark 自豪地开源，我们相信每个开发者都应该可以选择拥有自己的数据堆栈，而不受供应商锁定。

此外，Lark Cloud 可供那些希望我们处理 DevOps 的人使用，这样您就可以专注于构建您的应用程序，同时知道您将来始终可以选择转移到自己的堆栈上。

有关在 Lark 上构建的完整文档（客户端 SDK、安全规则、REST API 和 Firebase SDK 兼容性）位于 docs.larksh.com。 本仓库中的 docs/ 文件夹涵盖了 Lark 本身的运行：部署、备份、可观察性和内部结构。 有关 Lark 的测试方式，包括运行 Firebase 自己的 SDK 测试套件以及对耐久性合约进行碰撞测试，请参阅 TESTING.md。

快速启动

如果您是第一次探索 Lark，您可能有两个目标：首先，让 Lark 在本地计算机上运行，​​以便您可以探索该平台；其次，看到上面运行着一些简洁的东西，这样你就可以感受到什么是可能的。

为此，您需要 make 和 Docker。 克隆 repo 并从预构建的镜像中启动 Lark：

git clone https://github.com/lark-sh/lark.git
cd lark
make up-release

仪表板位于 http://localhost:8080/admin/，第一次启动时，管理员电子邮件和一次性密码会打印在日志中。 将在 repo 目录中创建一个 lark-data 文件夹，其中包含您的数据；备份此文件夹以备份您的数据，或者如果您想重新开始，请将其删除。

想要在公共互联网上使用它吗？ 几分钟内，deploy/fly/quickstart.sh 在 Fly.io 上建立起真正的、以 TLS 终止的 Lark 部署（您需要一个域名）。 请参阅deploy/fly/README.md。

尝试一个示例应用程序

如果你想看看 Lark 上运行的东西，请查看 Examples/ 文件夹：

  • 粘滞便笺是直接在@lark-sh/client 上构建的多人白板。 约 300 行普通 TypeScript 中存在实时光标、可拖动注释、快照插值运动和可变路径。 如果您要在 Lark 上构建新应用，请从这里开始。
  • Firebase快速入门针对Lark运行Firebase自己的quickstart-js/数据库社交博客应用程序，并更改了几行。 如果您想了解如何轻松地将现有的基于 Firebase SDK 的应用迁移到 Lark，请从这里开始。

自己编译一下

如果您想从源代码编译 Lark 而不是依赖预构建的 Docker 镜像，请运行 make up 而不是 make up-release ——它是相同的堆栈，是根据结帐中的代码构建的。

项目状况

Lark 是一个由生产服务支持的新开源项目：Lark Cloud 运行相同的代码库并在其上托管真实的客户数据。 该引擎根据明确的耐久性合同进行持续测试，并根据 Firebase 自己的 SDK 测试套件进行验证； TESTING.md 描述了两者并展示了如何自己运行所有内容。

0.x 版本号反映了该项目的年龄，而不是已知的稳定性。 磁盘格式已经是我们在不提供迁移路径的情况下不会破坏的东西，并且我们预计除了新功能之外，配置或线路表面不会发生变化。 我们宁愿让 Lark 通过公有生产里程获得 1.0，也不愿凭自己的信心去宣称。 在此之前，0.x 版本中的重大更改很少见，记录在更改日志中，并且每当存储的数据受到影响时都会附有迁移路径。

发展

如果您正在寻找 Lark 如何工作的技术方面的详细信息，或者有兴趣在实际的 Lark 服务本身上进行编码，而不是仅仅在其上运行应用程序，请查看 CONTRIBUTING 以了解代码库的概述以及如何设置完整的开发环境。
